needs.title: Finland – Repair, maintenance and associated services related to marine and other equipment – VENESATAMIEN HOITO
needs.description: Varkauden kaupungin venesatamien hoidon urakka sisältää urakka-asiakirjoissa esitettyjen pienvenesatamien ja laitureiden hoidon urakka-asiakirjojen mukaisesti. Lisäksi urakkaan kuuluu rakennettujen rantapaikkojen sekä talvisäilytyspaikkojen hoito urakka-asiakirjojen mukaisesti. Urakkaan kuuluu venepaikkamaksujen valvonta kaikissa pienvenesatamissa, rakentamattomilla ja rakennetuilla rantapaikoilla ja talvisäilytyspaikoilla. Urakkaan kuuluu yksityislaitureiden valvonta kaupungin maalla sekä polttoainemyynnin järjestäminen Taipaleen matkailusataman veneilijöille.

research.statement: An integrated MnO₂-catalyzed hydrothermal regeneration strategy restores degraded LiFePO₄ cathode materials to a Li/Fe molar ratio of 0.98 and 142.3 mAh·g⁻¹ discharge capacity at 0.2 C.
research.caveat: Does not evaluate industrial-scale implementation, commercial plant economics, lifecycle emissions, or occupational exposures.

research.statement: A techno-economic model estimates that electric vehicle lithium-ion battery recycling profitability ranges from -$21.43 to +$21.91 per kWh depending on logistics, wages, pack design, and cathode chemistry.
research.caveat: Theoretical techno-economic simulation; does not report actual empirical profit-and-loss accounting or audited operational yields from operating commercial facilities.

research.statement: Recycling pathways for spent lithium-ion batteries can be systematically structured into unit processes and stages aligned with circular economy waste treatment frameworks.
research.caveat: Presents a descriptive taxonomy of treatment processes; does not measure recycling efficiency rates, costs, or lifecycle toxicity.

research.statement: End-of-life lithium-ion battery recycling faces acute environmental and occupational hazards from thermal runaway, fires, and toxic releases during collection, dismantling, and processing.
research.caveat: Academic review paper; does not measure incident rates under specific occupational safety standards or prove the field efficacy of suggested mitigation protocols.

research.statement: Upstream product design is a critical determinant governing the operational efficiency and economic viability of lithium-ion battery recycling systems.
research.caveat: Extremely brief bibliographic abstract lead; does not detail specific design modifications, recycling chemistries, recovery rates, or empirical cost-benefit analyses.
